newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Soccer-Veteran McGrath named in Ireland team.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Veteran McGrath named in Ireland team.

text.p: Derby County's veteran defender Paul McGrath was on Tuesday named in the Republic of Ireland team to meet Wales in this evening's friendly international in Cardiff.
McGrath, 37, last played for Ireland when he won a record 82nd cap in the 2-0 defeat by the Czech Republic in Prague last April.
Bolton Wanderers goalkeeper Keith Branagan and Wimbledon striker Jon Goodman will both make their debuts for the Ireland senior side against the Welsh.
The match kicks off at 1930 GMT.

TEAM: Keith Branagan (Bolton Wanderers); Kenny Cunningham (Wimbledon), Paul McGrath (Derby County), Ian Harte (Leeds United); Jason McAteer (Liverpool), Roy Keane (Manchester United), Alan McLoughlin (Portsmouth), Steve Staunton (Aston Villa, Captain), Terry Phelan (Everton); Tony Cascarino (AS Nancy), Jon Goodman (Wimbledon).
